name: army_ant_column_top
description: Army-ant raiding column from directly above, flowing right: a dense stream of small red-brown workers three bodies deep, legs and antennae visible, lighter #a0583a heads. Transparent between ants. Centre anchor, x -600..600 (the last ant of the two staggered rows pokes up to +27/+53 past +600 and is covered by the next tile), y -70..70. Tiles every 1200.
